title: Localize input tab and information focus diagnostics
changes: Use the displayed input-tab labels in localized selection and focus diagnostics, and localize the read-only information focus label while retaining structured page and item identifiers.
validation: Offline Linux combined menu/screen build passed six semantic selection tests and the input-tab navigation test, including English/Italian focus labels and stable item IDs. Both 594-entry language catalogs validate.
limitations: Runtime frontend build, native Windows and physical input were not checked; broader English-first audit remains open.
